units.source_text: 且说伊豫介家的那个小君，有时也前去参谒源氏公子，

en.t: Now, the young attendant from Iyo no Suke's household would sometimes go to pay his respects to Prince Genji,

units.source_text: 但公子不像从前那样托他带情书回去，因此空蝉推想公子怨她无情，与她决绝了，

en.t: but the prince no longer entrusted him with love letters to carry back as he had before, so Utsusemi supposed that he resented her coldness and had broken with her,
and she could not help feeling melancholy at heart.

units.source_text: 此时闻知公子患病，自然也很忧虑。

en.t: When she heard at this time that the prince was ill, she naturally felt very worried as well.

units.source_text: 又因不久即将随丈夫离京赴任地伊豫国，

en.t: And because she would soon leave the capital with her husband for his post in Iyo Province,
her heart felt even lonelier and more listless.

units.source_text: 她想试探公子是否已经将她忘记，便写一封信去，

en.t: Wanting to test whether the prince had already forgotten her, she wrote and sent him a letter,

units.source_text: 信中说：“侧闻玉体违和，心窃挂念，但不敢出口。

en.t: in which she said, "I have heard indirectly that your health is poor, and I worry about you in secret, though I dare not speak of it.
